name: metron
description: A local economic control and accounting layer for AI agents.

interface.longDescription: Set economic goals, apply deterministic spend policy, and keep a local evidence-backed ledger for agent payments.
defaultPrompt: Use METRON to show local economic status.

review.commerce_description: METRON makes bounded direct Circle x402 USDC payments. A policy ALLOW automatically persists the Spend Intent as APPROVED and does not require separate human approval. ESCALATE requires explicit persisted human approval before it becomes APPROVED; DENY cannot execute or be human-overridden. Daily spend and available operating capital are absolute caps. Custom or legal commercial terms and below-minimum deals require separate persisted pre-acceptance human approval; customer acceptance always requires a distinct final human approval before invoice creation. METRON reconciles authoritative Circle evidence before accounting. EconomicRegistry V1 is deprecated; shared V2 provenance is active on Arc Testnet and supports multiple unique revenue records per spend. Circle remains payment authority and SQLite/journals remain business truth. Registry failure never reverses reconciled payment or accounting. Users do not deploy or fund the shared registry. Status, service search, and estimate operations do not move funds. Testnet activity is not production settlement.
